# ipybox  : per orchestration_policy_v2.toml [ipybox] тА?Desktop native
#           disabled; WSL/headless worker explicit-enabled; K3 roles disabled
#           unless the packet carries needs_code_execution=true.
# ============================================================================

version: 2
model_source: config/orchestration_policy_v2.toml   # [models] section

roles:

  sol:
    model_ref: models.sol_model            # gpt-5.6-sol (root only)
    reasoning_effort_ref: models.sol_reasoning
    sandbox_mode: workspace-write
    tier: billed                           # SOLE billed layer
    ipybox: disabled                       # Desktop native plane
    notes: >-
      main thread; planning + adjudication only; governed by
      sol_tool_gate_v2 (fail-closed, externally attested loop_state,
      bounded planning lease).

  executor:                                # agents/worker.toml
    model_ref: models.v4_model             # weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash
    reasoning_effort_ref: models.v4_reasoning
    sandbox_mode: workspace-write
    tier: free
    pool: v4
    ipybox: wsl_headless_only              # explicit enable on WSL plane only
    notes: standing; one packet per spawn; CSV batches route through the
      same admission primitive as single dispatch (P1-2 fix).

  scout:
    model_ref: models.v4_model             # weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash
    reasoning_effort_ref: models.v4_reasoning
    sandbox_mode: read-only
    tier: free
    pool: v4
    ipybox: disabled
    notes: built-in explorer; idempotent; lost = re-run.

  reviewer:                                # agents/reviewer.toml
    model_ref: models.k3_model
    reasoning_effort_ref: models.k3_reasoning
    sandbox_mode: read-only
    tier: free
    pool: k3
    ipybox: disabled
    notes: >-
      NOT standing; release gate single spawn per wave; verdict goes in
      report.json ONLY (reply body is never machine-parsed тА?P0-7 fix).

  verifier:                                # agents/verifier.toml тА?L2 gate
    model_ref: models.k3_model             # cross-family blind-spot hedge
    reasoning_effort_ref: models.k3_reasoning
    sandbox_mode: read-only
    tier: free
    pool: k3                               # counts as K3 demand in queue_sync
    ipybox: disabled                       # unless needs_code_execution=true
    dispatched_by: harness/l2_consumer.py  # AUTOMATIC (P0-2 fix): exactly-once
    notes: >-
      L2 verifier; BLOCK/ESCALATE power only тА?a 'pass' exempts the packet
      from Sol per-packet review, never releases. Verdict enum:
      pass | redo | escalate_l2_5 | escalate_l3, in report.json only.

  plan_expander:                           # agents/plan_expander.toml тА?NEW
    model_ref: models.k3_model
    reasoning_effort_ref: models.k3_reasoning
    sandbox_mode: read-only
    tier: free
    pool: k3
    ipybox: disabled
    dispatched_by: harness/orchestration/plan_pipeline.py
    notes: >-
      K3 plan expander (E1): consumes a Sol DecisionSkeleton (<=1200 new
      tokens) and emits a schema-validated packet DAG. needs_decision
      entries route back to Sol as bounded adjudication packets тА?the
      expander never invents decisions. Output validated against
      plan_expander.schema.json BEFORE dag_assert.

  duty_officer:                            # agents/duty_officer.toml
    model_ref: models.v4_model             # weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash
    reasoning_effort_ref: models.v4_reasoning
    sandbox_mode: read-only
    tier: free
    pool: v4
    ipybox: disabled
    enforce: true                          # v2: absorber not generator (┬з2.3.2)
    notes: >-
      trigger-based; no write tools; no spawn power; ruling is not
      authorization. enforce=true means duty_retryable/duty_fixable
      re-dispatch instead of dead-lettering to Sol. Ruling read from
      report.json["ruling"] only.

# ============================================================================
# orchestration_policy_v2.toml 鈥?declaration face = enforcement face
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Purpose : single policy source for routing modes, token bands, hysteresis,
#           budget caps, gate-guard conditions, and model pins. Every key in
#           this file is READ by the code that enforces it (design invariant 2,
#           phase2_architecture_design.md 搂1.4).
# Readers : harness/l2_consumer.py, harness/layered_gate.py,
#           harness/result_reducer.py, harness/short_result_validator.py,
#           harness/lifecycle_supervisor_v2.py, hooks/sol_tool_gate_v2.py,
#           metering/model_token_share_v2.py
# NOTE    : concurrency numbers live ONLY in refill_policy.toml.
#           loop_config_v2.toml is a compatibility/documentation mirror.
#           (fixes P0-8.3 fifth-authority defect, phase1b 搂7 item 8).
# ============================================================================

schema = "codex-loop-orchestration-policy/v2"
policy_version = 2
status = "fable-audit-implementation"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model pins 鈥?models are read from HERE, never hardcoded in Python
# Root Sol remains the Desktop frontier model. Ordinary execution uses
# DeepSeek V4 Flash ultra; verification/review remains on Kimi K3 max.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[models]
sol_model = "gpt-5.6-sol"
sol_reasoning = "high"

k3_model = "weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6"
k3_reasoning = "ultra"
k3_context_tokens = 1000000
k3_compaction_tokens = 800000

v4_model = "weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash"
v4_reasoning = "ultra"
v4_context_tokens = 1000000
v4_compaction_tokens = 800000

# legacy aliases quarantined into their own bucket 鈥?NEVER counted as k3
legacy_aliases = ["gpt-5.6-terra", "gpt-5.6-luna", "gpt-5.6"]
# Every selectable ordinary-execution profile remains in the execution bucket
# across temporary provider switches; v4_model alone is the active spawn pin.
execution_aliases = ["weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash", "alibaba-token-plan/glm-5.2"]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ipybox 鈥?user constraint: do NOT re-enable Desktop ipybox
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[ipybox]
desktop_native_enabled = false          # Desktop native: ipybox DISABLED
wsl_headless_worker_enabled = true      # WSL/headless worker: explicit enable
k3_planning_verifying_enabled = false   # K3 plan/verify: disabled unless the
k3_code_execution_exception = true      #   task explicitly needs code exec

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Routing 鈥?three-mode switch (P0-1 fix, 搂2.1)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[routing]
mode = "cold_start"                  # cold_start | shadow | layered
                                        # flip to layered ONLY via layered_gate
rollback_mode = "cold_start"            # gate condition 6: rollback key
trivial_packet_direct_to_v4 = true
plan_expansion_min_packets = 3
plan_expansion_on_cross_platform = true
plan_expansion_on_release_or_audit = true
plan_expansion_when_sol_5h_above = 0.25
send_l2_consumer = "harness/l2_consumer.py"
explicit_high_risk_route = "direct_l3"
verify_sample_rate = 0.10               # deterministic hash sampling (搂2.6)

[l2_queue]
dir = "data/l2_queue"                   # relative to LOOP_ROOT, cross-platform
pending_file = "pending.ndjsonl"
l2_max_age_s = 900                      # unclaimed record older -> fail-visible
claim_heartbeat_interval_s = 15
claim_stale_after_s = 120               # no heartbeat for this long -> reapable
claim_max_reclaims = 2                  # after this the record escalates l3
consumer_heartbeat_max_age_s = 300      # gate condition 1 freshness bound

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Context / budget caps (Tier-2 task budgets, 搂3)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[context]
inherit_root_transcript = false
control_packet_compiler = "deterministic"
decision_skeleton_max_new_tokens = 1200
root_control_max_new_tokens_per_wave = 2000
ordinary_revision_max_new_tokens = 500
adjudication_packet_max_new_tokens = 2000
child_short_result_max_tokens = 500
child_short_result_max_chars = 2000     # 4 chars/token engineering constant
child_short_result_max_findings = 8

[validator]
enabled = true                          # gate condition 4
schema_id = "codex-loop-short-result/v2"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Token bands + hysteresis (meter v2, 搂2.4)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tokens]
metric = "production_effective_tokens"
primary_window_seconds = 18000          # 5h
minimum_denominator = 2000000
refresh_debounce_s = 60                 # event-driven, NOT weekly
stale_after_s = 7200                    # report older than 2x cadence -> STALE
sol_target_low = 0.15
sol_target_high = 0.25
# Allocation envelope: new root work is budgeted at 15% so observed share can
# converge toward the user's 20-25% operating band.  The observed emergency
# hysteresis remains 25%; these are deliberately different control layers.
sol_allocation_cap = 0.15
sol_hard_cap = 0.15
k3_floor = 0.20
k3_total_observation_low = 0.10
k3_total_observation_high = 0.25
k3_verify_observation_low = 0.02
k3_verify_observation_high = 0.08
v4_observation_low = 0.50
v4_observation_high = 0.75
structural_alert_sol_above = 0.25
structural_alert_k3_below = 0.05

[hysteresis]
enter_high_sol_share = 0.25
enter_samples = 2
leave_high_sol_share = 0.22
leave_samples = 2
critical_1h_share = 0.35
critical_5h_share = 0.35

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Budget controller states (Tier-2/3, 搂5.2)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[budget]
state_file = "data/budget/active.json"
throttle_at = 0.60
degrade_at = 0.85
break_at = 1.00
state_cooldown_s = 60
reclaim_on_completion = true
allocation_headroom = 0.30
planning_max_turns = 6
planning_max_new_tokens = 30000

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Governor (sol_tool_gate_v2, 搂2.5) 鈥?fail-closed, externally enforced
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[governor]
fail_mode = "closed"                    # default DENY on any sensor failure
decision_log = "data/governor/gate_decisions.ndjsonl"
planning_lease_file = "data/governor/planning_lease.json"
attestation_ledger = "data/governor/state_attestations.ndjsonl"
break_glass_env = "LOOP_GOVERNOR_OVERRIDE"
allowed_states = ["planning", "adjudication", "release_finalize"]
share_report = "data/usage/model_token_share_v2.json"

## OpenCodex Health Audit Report — 2026-08-14

### 1. Application & Install

The headless CLI (`codex.exe`) and the code-mode host (`codex-code-mode-host.exe`) are both present. Node.js v24.18.0 is available; npm is blocked by PowerShell's execution policy but is accessible via cmd.

### 2. Provider Configuration (cliproxy / OpenCodex proxy)

Config source: [`C:\Users\hzq00\.codex\config.toml`]

- **Active model**: `gpt-5.6-sol` at reasoning effort `high`
- **Provider**: `cliproxy` → `http://127.0.0.1:10100/v1` (wire API: responses)
- **Auth**: bearer token `sk-local-f8cde4532c16bcb2`; `requires_openai_auth = false`

The cliproxy service is **live and healthy**: the `/v1/models` endpoint responds in ~3.5s and returns 12 models, and the `/health` dashboard page returns HTTP 200. The service exposes all configured models including `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `weiwu-k3/kimi-k3`, `weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6`, `weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash`, and several alibaba-token-plan models.

### 3. LOOP Provider Routing State

Active model profile (from [`data/governor/model_profile.json`]): **`v4f-sonnet-review`**
- Execution: `weiwu/deepseek-v4-flash` @ ultra
- Review: `weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6` @ ultra

This diverges from the original K3-centric profile. The `orchestration_policy_v2.toml` assigns `k3_model = "weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6"` (Claude Sonnet 4.6), not `weiwu-k3/kimi-k3`, consistent with the profile.

**Provider health files:**

| Provider | Model | Status | Last error | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `weiwu` | `aws.claude-sonnet-4.6` | **healthy** | none | Last success ~0s ago at audit time |
| `weiwu-k3` | `kimi-k3` | **unhealthy** | `upstream_5xx` (HTTP 504) | Backoff until +300s from ts `1786698370` |

The `weiwu-k3/kimi-k3` provider is in backoff due to a 504 upstream timeout (last run: `adhoc-da7cdf9dc7-gate-db-wal-...`). The active `v4f-sonnet-review` profile routes K3/review work to `weiwu/aws.claude-sonnet-4.6` instead, so **current operations are not blocked by the kimi-k3 outage**.

Routing mode in `orchestration_policy_v2.toml`: `cold_start` (not yet promoted to `layered`). The layered gate authorization file shows PASS with all 13 conditions green (last recorded at ts `1786471862`, i.e., ~Aug 12).

---

### 4. Token Share & Budget State

Rolling 5h/24h/1h windows all show `INSUFFICIENT_DATA` (no tokens in those windows), which means the LOOP has been **idle for the past 5+ hours**.

The cumulative 7-day window (status: OK):
- Sol share: **42.3%** — significantly over the 15–25% target band (`sol_allocation_cap = 0.15`, `structural_alert_sol_above = 0.25`)
- K3 share: **9.5%** — below the 20% floor (`k3_floor = 0.20`) but above the 5% alert threshold
- V4 share: **48.3%** — within the 50–75% observation band

The budget state is reported as `HIGH`, but `budget.state = NORMAL` with `ceiling = 0` and all consumed entries zeroed, suggesting the budget controller has not been actively computing for this session. The HIGH flag appears to be carried from historical data.

**Sol 42.3% cumulative is a structural concern.** The policy sets `sol_allocation_cap = 0.15` and `structural_alert_sol_above = 0.25`, so the 7-day average is nearly 3× the cap. However, since the rolling 5h share is 0.0, the currently active wave (64 agents in the refill roster) is not contributing new Sol spend right now.

---

### 5. Refill / Wave State

From `data/refill/refill_state.json`:
- **Active agents**: 64 (all K3, V4=0)
- **Target**: 20 per parent, 80 total; K3 target 20, V4 target 60
- **Deficit**: 0 (queue empty)
- **Reason**: `queue_empty` — no pending work, no refill required
- **Parent session**: `019feacd-184e-7472-9f11-ea364c22e595`, manifest `p0-parent-final-backlog-20260814`

The 64 active count exceeds the per-parent target of 20 significantly. This is likely stale roster data from completed work — the progress ledger shows all packets in `REPORTED` or `DEAD_LETTER` state, and the queue is empty, so these are residual lifecycle entries, not live threads.

---

### 6. Dead Letters & Packet Recoverability

From `data/dead_letters/`:
- Numerous `adhoc-*` packets dead-lettered on 2026-08-13, all from historical wave manifests
- Several `parent-*` verifier packets (`K3反差补位审计`, `K3基线反差审计`, `K3重复出生对抗审计`, `K3恢复发布门`, etc.) dead-lettered via **timeout** (`last_fail_class: timeout`, 2 retry attempts exhausted) on 2026-08-13
- One `parent-9d62ba2b8e2e...` dead-lettered as recently as 2026-08-14 14:19

The K3 verifier timeouts are consistent with the `weiwu-k3/kimi-k3` provider being unhealthy. These packets cannot be automatically recovered — they require manual manifest re-injection or are accepted as completed losses (their acceptance criteria were read-only audits, so task integrity is not compromised).

The circuit breaker (`data/.breaker.json`) shows 1 fail recorded at ts `1786688345`, `open_until = 0` — breaker is **closed** (not tripped).

---

### 7. Recoverability Summary

| Component | Status | Recovery path |
|---|---|---|
| cliproxy endpoint | Healthy | N/A |
| `weiwu` (Claude Sonnet) | Healthy | N/A |
| `weiwu-k3` (kimi-k3) | Unhealthy — 504, in backoff | Auto-retry after backoff expires; profile already routes K3 work to weiwu/Sonnet |
| Budget controller | Idle (NORMAL, no active task) | Will activate on next wave dispatch |
| Circuit breaker | Closed | N/A |
| Dead-letter K3 verifier packets | Terminal — cannot auto-recover | Accept as historical; do not re-dispatch unless a new manifest explicitly requeues them |
| Sol cumulative share (42.3%) | Structural alert exceeded | New work will dilute this; no immediate action needed while queue is empty |
| Planning lease file | Missing (`data/governor/planning_lease.json` not found) | Governor will create on next planning phase entry; absence is normal when idle |

### 8. Key Risks

1. **Sol overrun (cumulative 7d: 42.3%)** — far above the 25% structural alert threshold. As soon as new work begins, the governor's fail-closed mode (`governor.fail_mode = closed`) will block spawn unless Sol share drops into band or `LOOP_GOVERNOR_OVERRIDE` is set.
2. **kimi-k3 unhealthy** — any profile that pins `review_model = "weiwu-k3/kimi-k3"` (e.g., `profiles.v4f`, `profiles.k3-only`, `profiles.glm`) will see K3 pool deficits until the provider recovers. Current active profile `v4f-sonnet-review` avoids this.
3. **Layered gate PASS is stale (~48h old)** — the last recorded authorization is from 2026-08-12. If the harness checks freshness before allowing layered mode transition, a re-run of the gate check may be needed.
4. **Exec roster shows 64 "active"** — these are likely stale lifecycle entries. If the lifecycle supervisor reads this as live capacity, it could suppress new spawns. Worth verifying against actual running Desktop/headless processes before the next wave.
